title: Conversational Triage & Ticket Routing Assistant
summary: Reduced manual tier-1 triage response latency by classifying customer intent, extracting structured order data, and drafting human-in-the-loop responses.
context_problem: Support agents spent 40% of their time collecting missing order identifiers and categorizing repetitive inquiries.
approach_solution: Designed multi-step prompt chains with schema validation to extract parameters before escalating edge cases to staff.
demonstrated_outcome: Demonstrated 85% accurate zero-shot intent categorization across 200 synthetic inquiry test suites.

title: Multimodal Customer Sentiment & Trend Synthesis Pipeline
summary: Turned 15,000+ unstructured product reviews into topic clusters, sentiment shifts, and actionable feature recommendations.
context_problem: Raw qualitative feedback was too voluminous for product managers to review systematically before quarterly planning.
approach_solution: Utilized Python scripts to batch-process sentiment embeddings and generate quantitative frequency distributions validated by manual sampling.
demonstrated_outcome: Delivered an automated analytical notebook that compressed weeks of feedback analysis into a 2-hour reproducible report.

title: Visual Explanations & Systems Infographic Architecture
summary: Combined generative diffusion models with structured typographic layout to produce editorial-grade diagrams explaining complex cloud architectures.
context_problem: Technical diagrams are often dry and impenetrable to executive stakeholders, while purely creative illustrations lack precision.
approach_solution: Generated textured visual metaphors using controlled Midjourney prompting, followed by vector compositing and precise typography in Figma.
demonstrated_outcome: Produced a 6-part editorial infographic suite adopted for internal engineering orientation.

title: Comparative Evaluation of Frontier LLMs on Tabular Logic
summary: Evaluated hallucination rates and logic failures across 50 tabular manipulation tasks, documenting prompting patterns that maximize deterministic output.
context_problem: Teams struggled to predict when LLMs fail silently on multi-variable spreadsheet transformations.
approach_solution: Constructed standardized stress-test prompts comparing chain-of-thought, code generation, and direct JSON output modes.
demonstrated_outcome: Synthesized a 24-page comparative playbook documenting prompt guardrails that reduced tabular error rates from 32% to 4%.
